_comment: Small curated offline dataset used by StubDictionarySource. NOT a real MeSH/UMLS extract — a placeholder until a licensed data source is wired up (see linking/umls_source.py).

terms.definition_text: Persistently elevated arterial blood pressure, conventionally defined as systolic >=130 mmHg or diastolic >=80 mmHg.
A chronic metabolic disorder characterized by insulin resistance and relative insulin deficiency, resulting in hyperglycemia.
Subjective sensation of difficult or labored breathing.
Elevation of body temperature above the normal circadian range, typically >=38.0C, usually due to an underlying pathologic process.
Discomfort or pain in the chest that may originate from cardiac, pulmonary, musculoskeletal, or gastrointestinal structures.
A biguanide antihyperglycemic agent that decreases hepatic glucose production and improves insulin sensitivity, used first-line in type 2 diabetes.
An ACE inhibitor used to treat hypertension and heart failure by reducing angiotensin II production.
Infection of the lung parenchyma, causing inflammation of the alveoli, commonly presenting with fever, cough, and dyspnea.
A beta-lactam antibiotic used to treat a range of bacterial infections, including community-acquired pneumonia.
Necrosis of cardiac muscle tissue resulting from prolonged ischemia, typically due to occlusion of a coronary artery.
